rationale: Federato returned no Policy for this submission, so no location, building or premium reached the canonical record. The insured's headquarters (Location 33, Chicago IL) and its 2 buildings are in the snapshot, and every value here but the premium is read from them: total insured value is the sum of those buildings ($23,279,000), the year built is their value-weighted mean, the construction class is the one holding the most value on the majority side of the acceptable/not split (77% acceptable), sprinklered follows the value-weighted majority (0%), and the five-year incurred loss is the 2 claims on the insured's other policies dated 2020-12-14 to 2025-12-14. The premium is the only figure with no source: it is this account's value at 0.432% of TIV, the median rate of the book's 6 full-value property placements. The merge grammar carries one reported building and one reported location, so the portfolio is summarised into a single entry.
